segments.name: self-storage
segments.description: Owns and operates self-storage properties, renting units to households and businesses.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the self-storage segment is the Company's only reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay rent to lease storage space, and property owners pay management fees.
revenueModel.evidence: The self-storage segment derives substantially all of its revenue from customers who lease self-storage space at the Company's self-storage properties and fees earned from managing self-storage properties.
